description: NaRhO₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RhO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent RhO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. Rh³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form RhO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent RhO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. All Rh-O bond lengths are 2.07 Å. O²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Rh³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Rh₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
